script: Decision: covered. The claimant reports a sudden supply-pipe burst damaging personal belongings, which falls within the listed peril of accidental plumbing discharge under active Coverage C. Coverage applies to the damaged belongings, not the leaking pipe itself; no material coverage gap remains. Next action: Approve coverage for the damaged personal belongings and proceed with valuation; do not include the leaking pipe under this peril.
